title: TACOS neuromodulator Mirror compression
paper: TACOS: Task Agnostic Continual Learning in Spiking Neural Networks, arXiv:2409.00021v1
hypothesis: A small context-generated neuromodulator code may compress TACOS per-synapse metaplastic state while preserving task-agnostic continual retention, with separate accounting for inference weights and resumable learning state.
required_native_control: Faithful TACOS reproduction with exact metaplastic update/indexing, eRBP, reference-weight, heterosynaptic decay, data stream and no task IDs or boundaries.
mandatory_comparators_if_unblocked: native TACOS m and W_ref state
Mirror context-generated m from identical activity trace
blocker: Paper and supplement do not specify an executable per-synapse m increment condition/indexing rule or enough timing/sample-duration detail to reproduce native TACOS; no official source repository or code was identified in bounded search.
decision: Do not substitute an arbitrary metaplastic SNN; preserve UNTESTED and continue to MA-964.
scope_boundary: No model training, synthetic proxy, or performance claim was produced.
